title: First victim of Crans-Montana fire identified as investigations continue
summary: Investigations into the victims of the Crans-Montana fire are still ongoing, with authorities having revealed one identity so far. It could take weeks before they are able to confirm identities and nationalities of the victims due to the severity of the burns. In the meantime, five days of national mourning have been announced.
